text:
tom.release: Proposal: soft-pin SDK 2.10.0 in us-west for the upcoming change window. We saw tokenizer boundary changes in the SDK that cause unexpected truncation for some multilingual prompts. Requesting blockers now.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy 5201229990 -> canary-us-west failed healthcheck: model-trans-zh job returned truncated output length mismatch. Logs: https://internal.deploy/5201229990

clare: Quick grep from canary logs: 
```
WARN tokenizer: boundary mismatch at byte 256
trace: tokenizer/bytepair.go:88
```

nina: Which models are impacted? My batch eval hit it on `trans-zh-v2` and `multilang-q3`. Short English models look fine.

tom.release: Impacted models are the bilingual ones that rely on the SDK's new grapheme cluster handling. This was expected for emoji/complex scripts but regressed for some CJK sequences. Not hitting all customers yet.

ops-bot: Pinlist updated: keep SDK 2.9.x as active in us-west pools until 20:00 UTC per soft-pin request.

ben: Heads-up: SDK 2.10.0 changed default tokenization behavior to normalize ZWJ sequences. We added a compatibility flag `--tokenize=legacy` but clients need to opt-in. Recommend checking `curl` sanity: 
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.internal/v1/tokenize -d '{"text":"用户👍🏽你好","mode":"legacy"}' | jq .tokens
```

eng-oncall: I'll wire a traffic split so new sessions are served by 2.9.x. Can also flip A/B to fallback if we see >1% truncation errors.

clare: Can we surface a quick canary health check for tokenization? Maybe `POST /v1/health/tokenize` with sample inputs and expected token count.

ben: Added to preflight. Script lives at https://go/internal/scripts/tokenize-preflight.sh. It posts 7 samples including CJK, emoji, Indic, and Arabic. Expect token-counts.json match.

nina: Is model-serving runtime affected? Or just SDK clients? I want to be sure that Dedicated pools aren't impacted.

tom.release: This is SDK-only: runtime unchanged. Dedicated pools that use older client libs are safe. We still need to coordinate any managed SDK rollouts (mobile SDKs update later today).

eng-oncall: Action list: 1) ops to pin SDK in us-west (done), 2) QA to run tokenize-preflight in canary (clare), 3) mobile team to hold 2.10 promotion (ben), 4) release to update notes and send deprecation warning to partners (tom).

clare: Running preflight now. Will report by +15m.

ben: Drafted release note blurb and compatibility table: https://go/internal/release-notes/sdk-2-10. Patch includes `--tokenize` flag and changelog entry. I'll add migration steps for customers using non-utf8 byte sequences.

deploy-bot: Reminder: If we proceed with unpin, schedule a 20m probe with synthetic multilingual traffic and watch `tokenize.truncation_rate`.

clare: PRELIM QA: 20 samples, two failures on `trans-zh-v2` with legacy vs new behavior mismatch. Captured traces.

tom.release: Ok we keep the soft-pin for now. If ben can ship a 2.10.1 that reintroduces legacy default or makes `legacy` opt-out by flag in 30m we can re-evaluate. Otherwise we'll extend hold to change window end.

ben: I'll push a patch to revert default normalization and cut 2.10.1-rc in 25m. Will post PR link when ready.

eng-oncall: I'll prepare rollback steps for mobile rollout and notify partners channel. If truncation_rate > 0.5% in next hour, we'll escalate to incident.

tom.release: Thanks. Keeping this thread open for updates. If 2.10.1-rc passes preflight we'll plan a 30m unpin probe and monitoring checklist. :white_check_mark:
